decisions.statement: A hook is in the akasha folder and is registered outside the akasha folder.
A hook is registered by the name its page has rather than by its path.
The path that name reaches is worked out at the call rather than at the spawn.
A hook is TypeScript rather than a shell script.
A hook that refuses names the akasha command that does the work asked for.
A hook says the calls the hook does not catch when the hook is asked.
A hook over the ways a shell writes a file samples an open world that is too many ways to name.

definition: how a tool call is judged
